# The second law

Thermodynamics claims; Physlib's Thermodynamics area is thin (halo).

claims.name: secondLaw_entropyIncrease
claims.statement: The total entropy of an isolated system never decreases.

claims.name: carnot_efficiencyBound
claims.statement: No heat engine between reservoirs $T_h > T_c$ exceeds efficiency $1 - T_c/T_h$.
